notes.title: Massive performance and gameplay overhaul coming soon
notes.content:
[p]Ever been playing your favorite local shooter on a cold summer's night and then within minutes your room is hotter than Miami Beach in August?

Well, you were probably playing MORE ENEMIES! The cutting edge of CPU frying. That's why we here at Lollygag Labs have partnered with basic optimization and are hard at work behind the scenes, making a big update that will vastly improve the abhorrent optimization that has plagued my game development projects for years.[/p][p][/p][p]What would pair nicely with this supposed optimization overhaul the devs are promising in the near future?

Well, here are my goals, and I will pull them all off to give the few players of this series something truly special
•Better environmental audio[/p][p]•Better gunplay[/p][p]•Cohesive storytelling[/p][p]•Better UI[/p][p]•Make MORE ENEMIES only perform like it does currently when run on toasters from 1986[/p][p]•Increase office exploration[/p][p]•Add skill tree[/p][p]•KEYBINDS[/p][p]•Redoing the game's third act[/p][p]•Better performance settings[/p][p]•Fix Steam achievements

Now I want to be clear that almost all of these I have already done on my developer build as of 8/29/25. The following weeks for me will hold bug testing and re-designing the game's third act, and just general optimization. Not to mention personal and professional reflection

Thank you for your time, and I hope to get this update in your hands ASAP.[/p][p]-Jumbo[/p][p][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: MORE ENEMIES Is Going Free-To-Play!
notes.content:
ENEMIES and MORE ENEMIES will soon be going free to play!

Unfortunately both of our titles never really got as popular as we had originally aspired for them to be and that is okay. To get our games out there regardless we will be making both of these titles free to play now and we thank our community for their time and hope we find more players!

Break a leg.
